items.title: How much does check-in frequency bound how late you can find out?
items.description: In the worst case, a struggling person's signals start right after a check-in — so the next check-in is the earliest point they could realistically be caught, if nothing was noticed in between. But per L3's own framework, a single signal isn't actionable — it takes about a week of a sustained pattern before it moves from 'mild' to 'moderate.' So checking in more often than that doesn't actually buy an earlier catch: the delay floors at that minimum pattern window. Drag the time between check-ins to see both effects. At 21 days (about 3 weeks), this reproduces Report B's actual timeline from L3.
items.compute: const minPatternWindowDays = 7; const worstCaseDelayDays = Math.max(params.checkInFrequencyDays, minPatternWindowDays); return { worstCaseDelayDays };

outputs.label: Worst-case days before a quiet struggle could be caught
